configuration.fact_matching_rule: Unicode casefold substring: normalize_fact(f) in answer.casefold()
configuration.citation_validity_rule: Each citation chunk_id exists in retrieved top-k AND is authorized for principal
configuration.citation_correctness_rule: Each required_fact has >=1 cited chunk whose text casefold-contains the fact
configuration.citation_completeness_rule: All required_facts have supporting citations (same as correctness aggregate)

metric_definitions.CORRECT_COMPLETE_ANSWER: Answerable case: answer present, all facts satisfied, citations valid/correct/complete, required docs cited, evidence authorized
metric_definitions.INCORRECT_ANSWER: Not primary label; folded into UNSUPPORTED_ANSWER when facts/citations fail
metric_definitions.UNSUPPORTED_ANSWER: Answer returned but fails completeness/citation/document/authorization checks, or should_abstain with answer
metric_definitions.SCORING_INDETERMINATE: Deterministic support cannot be resolved (missing cited text or ambiguous validity inputs)
